Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government digital payment systems.  21 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Whether the instant payment system is used or can be used for government disbursements to citizens, including social transfers, welfare payments, salaries, pensions, subsidies, grants, and emergency assistance.
Comments: World Bank Implementation Status & Results Report for the Benin Economic Governance for Service Delivery Program-for-Results reports a 31-Dec-2023 indicator where “0 percent of beneficiaries of the social programs receive digital G2P payments,” implying G2P digitization was not yet in active use for those programs at that time ([World Bank ISR – Benin Economic Governance for Service Delivery PforR](https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099092325063510323/pdf/P176763-2035557c-fe0f-4162-a072-04b417dfb137.pdf)). Given evidence indicates no G2P digitization for social program beneficiaries (at least through 2023), score as No.
